_about: Settings for house_rules.py. storage_prefixes lists the key prefixes an app may use when they differ from its code plus a colon (rule 4). Each waiver names a check, says why it is accepted for now and when it expires (at most 90 days out), and, for checks that count problems, the most it covers, so a new problem still fails.
